description: Diagnoses and fixes frontend performance: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), bundle size and code splitting, image formats and sizing, font loading, janky scrolling and animation, re-renders. Use when a page is slow or janky, the user shares Lighthouse or Web Vitals numbers, a large JS bundle or huge images, or asks to make the UI faster. Not for React/Next.js code-pattern review (use vercel-react-best-practices).
